Body: While being driven home after a long day of decision making, you spot <lover> jaywalking across a busy street.
Narrative 1: I politely asked <lover> not to jaywalk anymore, after I saw <him/her> illegally walk across a busy road. <He/She> assured me that <he/she> would be more safe and responsible in the future.
Narrative 2: I didn't say anything to <lover> after I saw <him/her> illegally walk across a busy road. I had more important things to worry about!
Narrative 3: I had <lover> ticketed after I saw <him/her> illegally walking across a busy road. The law is the law, and no one is above the law! Not even me and my family!
Narrative 4: I gently, but firmly, spanked <lover> on the booty, after I saw <him/her> illegally crossing a busy road. <He/She> giggled and promised me <he/she> would be good from now on.

Title: Face Time
Body: Your advisors remind you that you haven't been seen in public too much lately, and suggests that it may be a good idea to stage a photo-op.
Narrative 1: I had a great time holding babies, taking photos, and doing interviews at a children's hospital. It was my way of doing some good work while also getting some positive publicity.
Narrative 2: I had a humbling experience feeding the less fortunate, taking photos, and doing interviews at a homeless shelter. It was my way of doing some good work while also getting some positive publicity.
Narrative 3: I had a great time thanking police officers for their service, taking photos, and doing interviews at a police station. It was my way of doing some good work while also getting some positive publicity.
Narrative 4: I had a great time thanking soldiers for their service, taking photos, and doing interviews at a military base. It was my way of doing some good work while also getting some positive publicity.
Narrative 5: I had a great time chatting with foreign ambassadors, taking photos, and doing interviews at a foreign embassy. It was my way of doing some good work while also getting some positive publicity.
Narrative 6: I had a great time speaking with students, taking photos, and doing interviews on a college campus. It was my way of doing some good work while also getting some positive publicity.
Narrative 7: I had a great time firing guns, taking photos, and doing interviews at a gun show. It was my way of having fun while also getting some positive publicity.
Narrative 8: I had a humbling experience walking for a good cause, taking photos, and doing interviews at a march against domestic violence. It was my way of doing some good work while also getting some positive publicity.
Narrative 9: I had a great time removing trash from a river, taking photos, and doing interviews at a cleanup event. It was my way of doing some good work while also getting some positive publicity.

Title: After-Party Accusation
Body: You and <lover> just got into your car after a night of hobnobbing with VIPs at a masquerade ball fundraiser. As soon as the door closes, <he/she> accuses you of flirting with another politician.
Narrative 1: I admitted to <lover> that I was flirting with another politician at a masquerade ball. I assured <him/her> that it was merely a negotiation tactic, and that I had no attraction to the leader.
Narrative 2: I insisted that I was not flirting with another politician at a masquerade ball, after <lover> accused me of doing so. I don't know what <he/she> saw, but I didn't have any attraction to that politician, and I wouldn't have flirted even if I did.
Narrative 3: I played dumb after <lover> caught me flirting with another politician at a masquerade ball. I think <he/she> knew I was lying, but <he/she> seemed to let it go, probably because <he/she> knew it was innocent flirting.
Choice 4: Ask the driver for his opinion
Narrative 4: I asked my driver to mediate a fight between <lover> and I, after <he/she> accused me of flirting with another politician at a masquerade ball. It turned out that the driver used to be a marriage therapist, so he was able to help us to talk through the issue.

Title: Family Feud
Body: <lover> expresses frustration towards you because you haven't been spending much time with the family lately.
Choice 1: Remind <him/her> I'm busy changing the world!
Narrative 1: When <lover> started giving me grief about not spending enough time with the family, I subtly reminded <him/her> that I had been quite busy changing the world.
Choice 2: Spend more time at home with family
Narrative 2: I started dedicating more time to my family at home, after <lover> expressed frustration with my lack of quality family time.
Narrative 3: I had to remind <lover> that my current political responsibilities won't last forever, after <he/she> was giving me a hard time about not spending enough time with the family.
Narrative 4: I started including my family in my work , after <lover> expressed frustration with my lack of quality family time.

Title: Scared Speechless
Body: You're about to go on stage to deliver an important speech on healthcare when your internal security team informs you they just received a credible death threat in the mail.
Choice 1: Do the speech with additional security
Narrative 1: I made an important speech about healthcare, with some added security, after I received a death threat in the mail.
Narrative 2: I made an important speech about healthcare even though I received a death threat in the mail. I made sure to let the crowd know that a death threat doesn't scare me!
Narrative 3: After receiving a death threat in the mail one morning, I decided to cancel an important speech regarding healthcare that was scheduled for later that day.
Narrative 4: I assigned my best detectives to investigate a death threat I received in the mail. My guys were able to locate and arrest the perpetrator, and I was able to deliver the speech on healthcare a few weeks later.

Title: Royal Opinion
Body: The Queen has become quite outspoken regarding your performance of 'God Save the Queen' at a recent parliamentary event, describing your singing voice as "pathetically wretched".
Narrative 1: I took singing lessons for two hours a day, seven days a week, after the Queen publicly criticized my singing skills. Her jaw fell to the floor the next time I sang 'God Save the Queen' in her presence.
Narrative 2: I ignored the Queen's public criticism of my vocal skills after she heard me sing 'God Save the Queen' at a parliamentary event.
Narrative 3: I publicly apologized to the Queen after poorly singing 'God Save the Queen' at a parliamentary event. The audience was amused when I added that my singing career looked fairly bleak, and I should probably just stick to my day job.
Narrative 4: I publicly mocked the Queen's dancing skills, or lack thereof, after she openly criticized my singing skills.

Title: The Queen's Guard
Body: While sipping tea at a Garden Party at Buckingham Palace, you make a bet with the Queen that you can make one of her Guardsmen laugh out loud.
Choice 1: Tell him the Queen likes Dutch ovens
Narrative 1: I lost a bet with the Queen after failing to make a Guardsman laugh by saying how much she enjoys pranking Prince Philip with a rank Dutch oven. He did, however, let slip a quiet, but squeaky, fart.
Choice 2: Tell him the Queen spikes tea with gin
Narrative 2: I lost a bet with the Queen because I failed to make a Guardsman laugh when I told him that the Queen spikes everyone's tea at Garden Parties. He didn't even budge a smile.
Choice 3: Tell him my Big Ben is bigger than his
Narrative 3: I won a bet with the Queen after making a Guardsman burst into laughter by whispering in his ear that my Big Ben was more massive than his Big Ben.
Choice 4: Tell him he is fired if he doesn't laugh
Narrative 4: I won a bet with the Queen by making one of her Guardsmen laugh out loud. What she didn't know is I threatened to fire him if he didn't do as I requested.

Title: Big Ben Blowout
Body: Your advisors inform you that a terrorist organization is threatening to blow up Big Ben if you don't give them \243100,000,000.
Narrative 1: After a blackmail attempt by a terrorist organization, I informed them that our country does not, and never will, negotiate with terrorists.
Narrative 2: I gave a terrorist organization \243100,000 after being told they would blow up Big Ben if we didn't give him \243100,000,000. They said our offer was insulting and planned to continue with the bombing, but it never happened.
Narrative 3: I gave a terrorist organization \243100,000,000 after they threatened to blow up Big Ben if we didn't capitulate. They were never seen or heard from again.
Narrative 4: I ignored a terrorist organization that attempted to blackmail us by bombing Big Ben if we didn't give them \243100,000,000. They went ahead with the plan, but the bomb misfired, and the only damage sustained was a missing minute hand. The terrorists were caught and sentenced to life in prison.

Title: Damsel In Distress
Body: Your advisors inform you that a terrorist organization is threatening to blow up the Statue of Liberty if you don't give them $100,000,000.
Narrative 1: After a blackmail attempt by a terrorist organization, I informed them that our country does not, and never will, negotiate with terrorists.
Narrative 2: I gave a terrorist organization $100,000 after being told they would blow up the Statue of Liberty if we didn't give him $100,000,000. They said our offer was insulting and planned to continue with the bombing, but it never happened.
Narrative 3: I gave a terrorist organization $100,000,000 after they threatened to blow up the Statue of Liberty if we didn't capitulate. They were never seen or heard from again.
Narrative 4: I ignored a terrorist organization that attempted to blackmail us by bombing the Statue of Liberty if we didn't give them $100,000,000. They went ahead with the plan, but the bomb misfired, and the only damage sustained was Lady Liberty losing a pinky toe. The terrorists were caught and sentenced to life in prison.

Title: Undercover Artist
Body: Upon exiting a London Underground station, you observe a street artist using an iconic red phone box to create a work of art. Your guards begin questioning the artist when he indicates that he is the real Banksy.
Choice 1: Get his autograph and let him work
Narrative 1: I got Banksy's autograph and spent some time picking his brain after stumbling upon him in the act of creating street art in London. The man is a legend and a genius!
Choice 2: Let him off with a warning
Narrative 2: I gave Banksy a warning after I discovered he was vandalizing a red phone box in the name of art. I told him that I respect him as an artist, but that he had to stop damaging public property, or else there would be legal consequences.
Narrative 3: I had Banksy arrested and charged on several counts of vandalism after I discovered him using a red phone box to create street art. I told him that destroying other people's property is unacceptable, and it wouldn't be tolerated.
Narrative 4: I helped Banksy with one of his projects after stumbling upon him using a red phone box to create street art. The work was a sensation around the world, and no one but Banksy and my guards knew that I helped to create it!

Title: State Affair
Body: The federal government has been receiving a lot of bad publicity lately after a series of embarrassing stories surfaced. You're considering a plan to redirect the media attention toward one of the states instead.
Narrative 1: I deflected negative national media attention toward the state of Alabama by getting the public to question why sex toys are illegal in their state.
Narrative 2: I deflected negative national media attention toward the state of Arkansas by getting the public to question why it's illegal to mispronounce "Arkansas," in their state.
Narrative 3: I deflected negative national media attention toward the state of Colorado by getting the public to question why their state changed its 420-mile marker to 419.99.
Narrative 4: I deflected negative national media attention toward the state of Florida by getting the public to question why their state has the highest rate of public masturbation in the country.
Narrative 5: I deflected negative national media attention toward the state of Indiana by reminding the public that their state tried to round pi up to 3.2.
Narrative 6: I deflected negative national media attention toward the state of Michigan by reminding the public that a county in Michigan once sent $1.25M to a Nigerian scammer.
Narrative 7: I deflected negative national media attention toward the state of Oklahoma by getting the public to question why their state vegetable is a fruit.
Narrative 8: I deflected negative national media attention toward the state of Utah by getting the public to question why a teacher in their state once got fired for writing a blog about homophones.
Narrative 9: I deflected negative national media attention toward the state of New Hampshire by pointing out that their license plates, which read, "Live Free or Die," are fabricated by convicts in prison.

Title: Houses vs. Hippies
Body: You've just approved a measure to develop a much-needed affordable housing project in your <jurisdiction> when an environmental group begins protesting the removal of a 200-year-old maple tree as part of the development plan.
Narrative 1: I ignored the protests of an environmental group that made a big deal over some old tree being cut down because what our constituents really need are more low-income housing options.
Narrative 2: I ordered the developers of an affordable housing project to redesign their plan to avoid cutting down a 200-year-old maple tree, and I authorized tax breaks to mitigate the added cost of redesign.
Narrative 3: I reversed my decision to authorize the building of a low-income housing project after I discovered the project necessitated the killing of a 200-year-old maple tree.
Narrative 4: After learning from an environmental group that there was a 200-year-old maple tree in our <jurisdiction>, I immediately drove to its location and climbed to the top. What a view!

Title: Sky High Crime
Body: A recent news report shows your <jurisdiction> has one of the highest crime rates in the nation, and your constituents are demanding action from your office.
Narrative 1: I read a report that the crime rate in our <jurisdiction> was out of control and immediately hired additional police forces.
Narrative 2: After reading a report claiming our <jurisdiction> had a high crime rate, I made a public address discrediting the bogus information, and I assured the citizens they were safe.
Narrative 3: I read a report claiming that our <jurisdiction> had a very high crime rate but dismissed it as fake news.
Narrative 4: After a report circulated claiming our <jurisdiction> had one of the highest crime rates in the nation, I called a press conference to make it clear that the prior administration's policies created the problem.

Title: Pandemic Precautions
Body: An internal audit on disaster recovery has concluded that, in the unlikely instance of a global pandemic, your <jurisdiction> is vastly unprepared to deal with the crisis.
Narrative 1: I received an audit report showing our <jurisdiction> was unprepared for the unlikely instance of a global pandemic, and even though it sounded like an extremely remote possibility, I decided to organize a task force to look into the matter just in case.
Narrative 2: I received an audit report showing our <jurisdiction> was unprepared for the unlikely instance of a global pandemic, but I dismissed the findings as too extreme of a likelihood to warrant taxpayer spending.
Narrative 3: I received an audit report showing our <jurisdiction> was unprepared for the unlikely instance of a global pandemic. In response, I offered tax incentives to manufacturing entities to help us prepare the necessary items.
Narrative 4: After receiving an audit report that wasted time and taxpayer money assessing remote existential threats, I reassigned the auditors to duties that were more valuable to our <jurisdiction>.

Title: Social Warfare
Body: The opposing party has accused your office of consistently favoring big business over social welfare.
Narrative 1: When the opposition accused our party of favoring big business over social welfare, I accused them of ineptitude and corruption.
Narrative 2: When the opposition accused our party of favoring big business over social welfare, I pointed out the obvious fact that without big business, there are no taxes, and without taxes, there is no money for social welfare.
Narrative 3: I simply ignored the opposition after they, yet again, accused our party of favoring big business over social welfare.
Narrative 4: When the opposition accused our party of favoring big business over social welfare, I offered to work with them in a bipartisan manner to ensure that both business profits and social welfare issues were equally addressed.

Title: Say Anything
Body: A political watch group is accusing your office of spying on the opposing party's election headquarters. You have no knowledge of the activities in question, but your advisors are saying you need to respond to avoid the appearance of guilt.
Narrative 1: A political watch group accused my office of spying on the opposition party's election headquarters. I responded by demanding a third-party, disinterested source provide incontrovertible evidence supporting the accusation.
Choice 2: Dismiss the group as fringe radicals
Narrative 2: A political watch group accused my office of spying on the opposition party's election headquarters. I publicly dismissed the group as a bunch of fringe radicals.
Narrative 3: A political watch group accused my office of spying on the opposition party's election headquarters. I responded by authorizing a thorough internal investigation into the matter.
Choice 4: Announce that I'm not a crook
Narrative 4: A political watch group accused my office of spying on the opposition party's election headquarters. I responded by making a public announcement, informing the people that I was not a crook.

Title: H2Oh No!
Body: A recent drought has nearly diminished reserve water supplies, and if you don't act soon, your <jurisdiction> might run out of water.
Narrative 1: When a drought threatened the water supply of our <jurisdiction>, I rallied public support to conserve water by implementing the "if it's yellow, let it mellow, if it's brown, flush it down" toilet policy.
Narrative 2: When a drought threatened the water supply of our <jurisdiction>, I negotiated with a neighboring jurisdiction to purchase some of their water if necessary.
Narrative 3: When a drought threatened the water supply of our <jurisdiction>, I authorized the drilling of deeper boreholes.
Narrative 4: When a drought threatened the water supply of our <jurisdiction>, I gathered with some colleagues in the park, and we performed a rain dance, some of us wearing togas while others were just in their underwear.

Title: Poor Support
Body: Social activists are protesting a planned-growth policy you supported that, unbeknownst to you, grants permission to build a private golf course on lands allocated to affordable housing.
Narrative 1: I reversed my support on a planned-growth policy after discovering it would allow a private golf course to be built on affordable housing allocated land.
Choice 2: Require it to be a public course
Narrative 2: As part of a planned-growth policy to build additional affordable housing, I insisted the project include a public golf course with affordable green fees.
Choice 3: Buy real estate in the area
Narrative 3: After discovering that a policy I supported would allow a private golf course to be built on affordable housing land, I immediately contacted my real estate agent and snatched up some excellent investment properties.
Narrative 4: I reaffirmed my support on a planned-growth policy, regardless of it allowing a private golf course to be built on affordable housing allocated land.

Title: Trigger Warning
Body: An internal report indicates that an underprivileged segment of the <jurisdiction> is planning a violent protest in response to a gun-safety law you vetoed.
Narrative 1: After vetoing a controversial gun-safety law, I encouraged those who disagreed with my action to protest peacefully.
Narrative 2: After hearing of a potential violent protest over a gun-safety law I vetoed, I made the prudent choice of deploying military forces to the area.
Narrative 3: After hearing of a potential violent protest over a gun-safety law I vetoed, I tweeted out a message saying, "Imagine all the people, living life in peace".
Choice 4: Invite their leaders to a beer summit
Narrative 4: After hearing of a potential violent protest over a gun-safety law I vetoed, I immediately invited the protest group's leaders over to my place for a beer summit to discuss a peaceful solution.

Title: More Money More Problems
Body: You get a report from your treasury department showing a significant budget deficit. While campaigning, you promised your constituents there would be no new taxes, but now you need additional funding to balance the budget.
Narrative 1: Despite having promised not to raise taxes, I broke my promise and raised taxes in order to balance the budget.
Narrative 2: I covered a deficit in the budget by reallocating funds intended for education.
Narrative 3: I covered a deficit in the budget by reallocating funds intended for social welfare.
Narrative 4: I covered a deficit in the budget by reallocating funds intended for healthcare.
Narrative 5: I covered a deficit in the budget by reallocating funds intended for national security.
Narrative 6: I covered a deficit in the budget by reallocating funds intended for immigration.
Narrative 7: I covered a deficit in the budget by reallocating funds intended for environmental protection.

Title: No Quid Pro Quo
Body: A whistleblower has publicly accused you of putting the nation's security at risk by accepting an illegal quid pro quo from a foreign entity.
Narrative 1: A whistleblower accused me of accepting an illegal quid pro quo from a foreign nation. I dismissed it as fake news.
Narrative 2: I discredited the integrity of a whistleblower who accused me of accepting an illegal quid pro quo from a foreign nation.
Narrative 3: I authorized a full investigation into the claims of a whistleblower that I had accepted an illegal quid pro quo from a foreign nation.
Narrative 4: After a whistleblower accused me of accepting an illegal quid pro quo from a foreign nation, I had to ask, what is a quid pro quo?

Title: Enticing Intern
Body: While working alone at your desk late one evening, you look up to discover a female intern has entered your office. She begins to express sympathy for how hard you've been working lately and asks if she can help you relieve some stress.
Narrative 1: Late one night in my office, I hooked up with an intern who offered me some stress-relieving pleasure.
Narrative 2: Late one night in my office, I accepted an offer from an intern who gave me the most amazing, stress-relieving, shoulder massage ever.
Narrative 3: I graciously declined an offer from a provocative intern who wanted to hook up with me late one night in my office.
Narrative 4: Late one night in my office, I terminated an intern on the spot after she suggested giving me oral pleasure as a means to help reduce stress.

Title: Enticing Intern
Body: While working alone at your desk late one evening, you look up to discover a male intern has entered your office. He begins to express sympathy for how hard you've been working lately and asks if he can help you relieve some stress.
Narrative 1: Late one night in my office, I hooked up with an intern who offered me some stress-relieving pleasure.
Narrative 2: Late one night in my office, I accepted an offer from an intern who gave me the most amazing, stress-relieving, shoulder massage ever.
Narrative 3: I graciously declined an offer from a provocative intern who wanted to hook up with me late one night in my office.
Narrative 4: Late one night in my office, I terminated an intern on the spot after he suggested giving me oral pleasure as a means to help reduce stress.

Title: Book Crook
Body: Your friend owns a business that sells textbooks to schools, and he confides in you that his company has been struggling to compete with the internet. He then asks if you'll propose a mandate banning schools in your <jurisdiction> from purchasing textbooks online.
Narrative 1: I ignored my friend after he asked me to propose a mandate that would benefit his textbook business.
Narrative 2: To help my friend's textbook business, I proposed a mandate that would ban all schools in my <jurisdiction> from purchasing their books online.
Narrative 3: I reported to the authorities that my friend asked me to propose a mandate that would benefit his textbook business.
Narrative 4: To help my friend's textbook business, I proposed a mandate that would ban all schools in my <jurisdiction> from purchasing their books online. To help myself, I invested in his business before the mandate took effect.

Title: Tourist Trap
Body: In an effort to increase tourism, you've hired a marketing company to develop a campaign based on the most attractive features of your <jurisdiction>. They ask you to choose what area to focus on the most.
Narrative 1: To increase tourism in my <jurisdiction>, I hired a marketing firm to develop a campaign that highlighted the friendliness of our residents.
Narrative 2: To increase tourism in my <jurisdiction>, I hired a marketing firm to develop a campaign that highlighted our outstanding array of chef-inspired restaurants.
Narrative 3: To increase tourism in my <jurisdiction>, I hired a marketing firm to develop a campaign that highlighted our spectacular expanse of breathtaking landscapes and views.
Narrative 4: To increase tourism in my <jurisdiction>, I hired a marketing firm to develop a campaign that highlighted our exciting nightlife and bass-thumping party scene.

Title: Rogue Drones
Body: Every night for the past week, you've received eyewitness reports from concerned citizens regarding a swarm of strange drones flying in formation over remote parts of the <jurisdiction>. Wild rumors are beginning to circulate, and the people are looking to you for an explanation.
Narrative 1: With orders to shoot if necessary, I deployed a local military unit to investigate a swarm of strange drones that were repeatedly flying in the night sky, terrifying our citizens.
Choice 2: Announce it's the end of the world
Narrative 2: I recognized the event of drones flying in the night sky as a sign of the end of times, and I immediately announced to our citizens that the world was about to end.
Choice 3: Offer a reward for drones captured
Narrative 3: After hearing numerous eyewitness accounts of mysterious drones flying in the night sky, I issued a cash reward to anyone who delivered me a captured drone.
Narrative 4: After hearing multiple eyewitness accounts of mysterious drones flying in the night sky, I reassured my citizens it was nothing to worry over.

Title: Regulating Refuge
Body: A recent conflict in a war-torn neighboring country has forced refugees to your border seeking asylum. The problem is, you don't know which of them are friendly and which are not.
Narrative 1: When a bloody conflict broke out in a neighboring country, I allowed all asylum-seeking refugees into our country.
Narrative 2: When a bloody conflict broke out in a neighboring country, I refused to allow any of their asylum-seeking refugees into our country.
Narrative 3: When a bloody conflict broke out in a neighboring country, I only allowed women and children to seek asylum in our country.
Narrative 4: When a bloody conflict broke out in a neighboring country, I protected the citizens of my country by building a massive wall between our nations.

Title: Homeless Helping
Body: While attending a lavish fundraising dinner for the underprivileged, you notice an uninvited homeless man attempting to sneak into the buffet line.
Narrative 1: I called security on a homeless man who tried to sneak into the buffet line at our lavish fundraising dinner event.
Narrative 2: I noticed a homeless man who entered our lavish fundraising event with the intent to steal food, but I just looked the other way, and everyone else did as well.
Narrative 3: I saw a homeless man attempting to steal food from our lavish fundraising event, and I helped him fill a plate full of gourmet foods.
Narrative 4: When a homeless man entered our lavish fundraising event with the intent to steal food, I seized upon the serendipitous opportunity and invited him to address our philanthropic gathering.

Title: Incoming!
Body: NASA has just informed the world that a massive asteroid is heading directly toward Earth and has a 98% chance of striking your country. As the leader of your nation, the citizens are looking to you for a solution.
Narrative 1: After being notified by NASA that an asteroid had a 98% chance of striking our country, I commissioned the military to fire a nuclear missile at the incoming threat, and successfully diverted it away from our nation where it hit <country-other> instead.
Narrative 2: After being notified by NASA that an asteroid had a 98% chance of striking our country, I commissioned the launching of a gravity tractor to pull it off course, thus saving the world from utter destruction.
Narrative 3: After being notified by NASA that an asteroid had a 98% chance of striking our country, I commissioned the use of solar electric propulsion to push it off course, thus saving the world from utter destruction.
Narrative 4: After being notified by NASA that an asteroid had a 98% chance of striking our country, I immediately booked a flight to <country-other> in order to avoid the catastrophe.

Title: Shroom Sesh
Body: A new-age advocacy group is petitioning to legalize psilocybin mushroom therapy sessions for licensed practitioners in your <jurisdiction>, and they're citing multiple cases where trauma and addictions were alleviated by using this cutting edge approach.
Narrative 1: I refused to consider the legalization of psilocybin therapy because, as everyone knows, magic mushrooms are just another gateway drug without any potential medical benefits whatsoever.
Narrative 2: I refused to consider the legalization of psilocybin therapy because it seemed like fake science to me.
Narrative 3: I agreed to support a measure to legalize psilocybin therapy but only with strict oversight by the medical and law-enforcement communities.
Narrative 4: After learning about psychiatrists who were experimenting with psilocybin therapy and reporting amazing benefits, I immediately gave my full support to a measure that would legalize the use of magic mushrooms.

Title: Playing With Food
Body: Your school district's lunch program is being criticized for not offering the students any nutrient-dense lunch options that are fun to eat. An aspiring cafeteria cook has come up with some ideas and asks you which one sounds best.
Narrative 1: In response to a lack of nutrient-dense lunch choices in our school cafeterias, I chose to start including crunchy kale bites as a super fun option for our students to eat more healthily.
Narrative 2: In response to a lack of nutrient-dense lunch choices in our school cafeterias, I chose to start including roasted broccoli pops as a super fun option for our students to eat more healthily.
Narrative 3: In response to a lack of nutrient-dense lunch choices in our school cafeterias, I chose to start including Brussels sprouts poppers as a super fun option for our students to eat more healthily.
Narrative 4: In response to a lack of nutrient-dense lunch choices in our school cafeterias, I chose to start including spinach pinwheels as a super fun option for our students to eat more healthily.

Title: Budget Bail
Body: You forgot to study the budget proposal that was given to you three weeks ago, and tonight is the budget meeting, which means you're out of time.
Narrative 1: Even with a three-week advance notice, I still forgot to study the budget proposal for our meeting and had to fake it through the entire session.
Narrative 2: I forgot to study the budget proposal that was given to me three weeks in advance of our planning meeting, so I decided the best thing to do was call in sick.
Narrative 3: I forgot to study the budget proposal that was given to me three weeks in advance of our planning meeting, so I copied notes from another board member and presented feedback as my own.
Narrative 4: I forgot to study the budget proposal that was given to me three weeks in advance of our planning meeting, so I rescheduled the session to provide me with another three weeks to prepare.

Title: Cash Only
Body: While walking downtown during your lunch break, a homeless man approaches you, asking for money. You tell him about a job opening working as a night janitor for the school district, but he declines saying he doesn't want to work.
Narrative 1: I offered a homeless man a job as a night janitor, but he didn't want it, so I gave him some spare coins I had in my pocket.
Narrative 2: A homeless man approached me while I was walking downtown on my lunch break, and he asked for money, but I just walked away without even looking at him.
Narrative 3: A homeless man approached me downtown asking for money, so I lectured him on the value of hard work and self-reliance.
Narrative 4: I called the police on a homeless man who was badgering me for money during my lunch break downtown.

Title: Vulgar Impulse
Body: You're speaking at a press conference about the outstanding ethics of your administration when you accidentally let slip the F-word in describing a political opponent.
Narrative 1: I immediately apologized after letting a profanity slip out while describing a political opponent during a press conference.
Narrative 2: After being accused of using the F-word to describe a political opponent during a press conference, I told reporters that I described my opponent's laziness as being so regal that he deserved the title of "sofa king" lazy.
Narrative 3: After letting a profanity slip out while describing a political opponent during a press conference, I decided to double-down and used the expletive a second time.
Narrative 4: After letting a profanity slip out while describing a political opponent during a press conference, I just carried on as if it didn't happen.

Title: Friend Freebie
Body: A good friend of yours just lost her job and is asking if there's any way you could put her on the payroll without her working and, even more importantly, without anyone knowing.
Narrative 1: I hooked up my good friend with a generous salary paid "under the table," and she didn't even have to work for it.
Narrative 2: I told my good friend who asked me for a generous salary paid "under the table" that it was entirely unethical, and there's no way I would ever do such a thing.
